details:
I have many avatars uploaded, and i notice the missing feature to find quicker some uploaded avatars.

The list is very long and takes long time to scroll it up without search for tag or name in avatar text.

Many users in VRChat, especially content creators / vtubers have many avatars. 

The sorting order is there, like new uploaded and last updated. Good, but it works for short time.

With much longer list, the functions will not help much.

So we need search bar to find own avatars. We have it already for friends and world search.

Website offers search for favorite avatars. Good. Now please do it for personal uploaded avatars too. But ingame search is also important.

Many people made posts already:

(in 2025) https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/avatar-search-for-personal-avatars 

(in 2021) https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/created-avatars-search-function

(in 2025) https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/add-a-search-bar-option-for-uploaded-avatars

(in 2022) https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/1236-search-for-uploaded-and-favourited-avatars

(in 2023) https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/personal-avatar-text-search

and even OLD 2018 thread: https://vrchat.canny.io/feature-requests/p/avatar-search-functionalities-personal-avatars

What is going on here? It was pretty much requested feature since 2018, but it's not even added for uploaded avatars.

Only favorite avatars has the feature, but we really need for own avatars. Some have so many uploaded over 5-8 years time, and it's more pain in the ass too. Come on, please make this possible.
title: Add search function for personal avatars
